program_chi: 雙渠道雙語研究文學士
learning_outcomes:
BMBL_Learning outcomes 1. Major Programme: Upon completing
the programme, students will have: 1. Achieved a new understanding
of how knowledge of language is organized and transmitted through the
visual-spatial modality, as opposed to spoken languages, organized and
transmitted in fundamentally different ways; 2. Appreciated how this new
understanding can potentially transform the society’s perception about sign
language, giving it a linguistic status that is equal to spoken
languages; 3. To
be able to evaluate critically the development of bimodal bilingualism in
society from the perspective of information accessibility and effective
communication in domains of education, social and public communication, child
care, counselling and clinical services; and 4. To
be proficient in spoken
languages and sign languages in order to undertake responsibilities in
professional settings which call for such linguistic skills.
2. Minor Programme: Upon completion of the
programme, the student will have: 1. a
reasonable level of communicative competence in HKSL, including being able to comprehend and
interact with deaf people in HKSL with a reasonable level of confidence; 2. an
understanding of the visual communication strategies of Deaf people; 3. knowledge
of Deaf culture and the readiness for appreciating linguistic and cultural diversity in society; 4. an
understanding that deafness is not a disability and the Deaf Community can be
viewed as a linguistic
minority group with its unique culture; 5. a
general understanding of the grammar of HKSL especially how it differs from
the local spoken
languages; and 6. knowledge
of the potential adoption of HKSL in social, education and professional practices.

Programme Requirement
Students
are required to complete a minimum of 18 units of courses, with at least
6 units at 3000 or above level, as follows:
Units
1.  |  Required
Courses[a]:
(a)  |  HKSL1000
and 1002, or 1003  |  6
(b)  |  HKSL2001
and 2002, or 2003  |  6
2.  |  Elective
Courses:
BMBL3002,
3003 or any HKSL courses at 3000 or above level  |  6
Total:  |  18
Explanatory
Notes:
1.  |  This
Minor Programme is not applicable to students who major in Bimodal
Bilingual Studies.
2.  |  Linguistics
Major students can only take HKSL courses to fulfill the requirement of
(2).
3.  |  No
more than 9 units of courses taken to fulfill the requirements of the
students’ Major Programme(s) and other Minor Programme(s) respectively
can be used to fulfill the requirement of this Minor Programme.
[a]  |  Students
who have prior knowledge of Hong Kong Sign Language before admission may
be exempted from taking HKSL1000, 1002, 1003, 2001, 2002 and 2003. They
should seek the advice of the Department to take substitute courses in
accordance with their academic qualifications.
